subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should maintainers preserve this PR by rebasing its secure Tailscale and auth-recovery pieces onto the newer iOS onboarding flow that already merged?
rationale: The branch conflicts with a merged onboarding redesign and touches the iOS gateway trust boundary, so automation should not choose which UX structure survives the conflict.

options.title: Refresh Onto Current Onboarding
options.body: Rebase or manually port only the useful secure Tailscale and password-auth pieces onto the current main onboarding architecture, then re-run focused iOS proof.

options.title: Extract A Narrow Follow-Up
options.body: Close or pause this branch after opening a smaller PR for the raw-IP block and auth-recovery copy if the full chooser no longer fits current UX direction.

options.title: Pause For Product Direction
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not repair it until maintainers decide whether Tailscale should be a first-class onboarding path or only a documented advanced route.

recommendation.title: Refresh Onto Current Onboarding
recommendation.body: Rebase or manually port only the useful secure Tailscale and password-auth pieces onto the current main onboarding architecture, then re-run focused iOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged onboarding refresh by this contributor is the overlapping surface the PR must now reconcile with.
